# Codapult Guard fixture

`guard-verification.sigstore.jsonl` is copied unchanged from
[codapult/codapult-guard](https://github.com/codapult/codapult-guard/tree/main/docs/attestations/examples/github-actions)
(commit c82d5d0). It is a real Guard verification Statement, signed through
Sigstore by `js-toolkit/changesets-guard-validate`'s trusted workflow, followed
by its SLSA provenance. The tests use it to check that Slipmark reads Guard's
predicate v1 exactly as Guard's spec defines it.
